entries.text: What's changed Added sign-in to organizations managed in Anthropic's Enterprise Admin Console: after claude auth login, Claude Code applies the organization's settings and uses its cloud provider or gateway Added easel, a built-in mod that draws charts when asked and under MCP metrics results, on Pro, Max and, where available, Team and Enterprise on macOS and Linux; turn automatic charts off in /config Added CLAUDE_CODE_FULL_SIGN_IN_LINK=1 to print the full sign-in link, if the short one shows an error or a script reads values from it Self-hosted runner: Added --start-dir / SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_START_DIR to have Claude start its work in a folder of a repository, while settings and hooks load as without it Added a notice in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions when a plugin marketplace can't be fetched because its repository isn't one of the session's Self-hosted runner: Added a notice when Anthropic-managed git refuses a plugin's own repository, naming the plugin and what to do Added commandPrinted to claude plugin install --json results, true when the plugin's install command wrote to stderr, and commandFailed when it exited with an error, was killed or timed out Added claude_code_self_hosted_runner_order_to_registered_seconds to the self-hosted runner's /metrics: seconds from work order issued to registration accepted, on orchestrator-spawned runners Added claude_code_self_hosted_runner_order_to_first_session_seconds to the self-hosted runner's /metrics: seconds from work or

entries.text: What's changed Added a trust dialog warning that says where a folder's hooks are declared Added a warning in the conversation, in Claude Desktop and other non-interactive hosts, when hooks in managed settings fail to load Added this session's scheduled tasks, /loop wakeups, the goal and this conversation's forks to /tasks; x stops one after asking Added a "Server message" row to a server's page in /mcp that shows the JSON-RPC error message of a remote HTTP MCP server that refuses the connection Added a "Marketplace auto-update" row to /status that names managed marketplaces that get no automatic updates, and why Added support for turning on Code Mode while OpenTelemetry events and metrics are enabled; each tool call the code makes sends its events; tracing still keeps it off Fixed ~/.claude.json sometimes being reset to defaults when a network stall or file lock made it unreadable and cleared during a save Fixed repeated sign-outs on macOS when Claude Code could read the Keychain but not save to it. That session now stops at expiry and says why, and other sessions stay signed in Fixed /terminal-setup corrupting VS Code settings or keybindings files around block comments, and reporting success while losing the Shift+Enter binding where keybindings.json has an unclosed string Fixed files accepted through the IDE diff being saved without their last newline, and losing their byte order mark (BOM) when an edit was accepted by saving the diff in VS Code Fixed picking a cloud sessio

entries.summary: Added auto mode for Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry and Claude apps gateway; interactive sessions with no permission mode start in it; Added…
entries.text: What's changed Added auto mode for Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 on Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud's Agent Platform, Microsoft Foundry and Claude apps gateway; interactive sessions with no permission mode start in it Added "onFailure": "block" for mcp_tool hooks, as for command and HTTP hooks: a hook whose call fails blocks the action Added a warning when a message from a session that skips permission prompts may be held and dropped by a cloud session Added a notice in /status and claude doctor when an OpenTelemetry exporter has no endpoint and its data would likely be lost Added CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_DEFERRED_TOOL_RESUME, which lets a host stop claude -p --resume and --continue from running a tool call that a hook deferred Added support for apps that embed Claude Code to switch on the policy plugin's allowManagedModsOnly option; an admin's managed settings still win Added a startup warning to the Claude apps gateway when a policy's maxEffortLevel is not a valid effort level Self-hosted runner: Added --repository-folder to name the folder that sessions use for a repository at --capacity 1, in place of its path under the base folder, which can't be a symbolic link Self-hosted runner: Added a start-up warning when the host's settings.json sets a default permission mode that sessions ignore Self-hosted runner: Added --hook-label to claude self-hosted-runner orchestrator, to hand chosen session labels to the spawn-runner hook Self-hosted runner: Added --metadata key=value to claude

entries.text: What's changed Added a confirmation before /install-github-app changes a repository Added claude mcp add-json <name> - to read the server's JSON from stdin, so tokens can stay off the command line; not available inside a Claude Code session Added a line when a resumed session's earlier messages can't be loaded Added a list in /status of broken agent, skill, command and output style files, keybinding errors, an unavailable sandbox, ignored permission settings and hook matchers that never match Added a note in /config when other settings override a row Added x-claude-code-managed-settings-checksum to the gateway hint headers; sent where managed settings set CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS=1, including where they already do Added support for naming a session's billing group with the attributionProject setting, for Claude apps gateways that set admin.billing_group_tag Added /tui classic as the name for the non-fullscreen renderer; /tui default still works Remote Control: Fixed stopping the server in worktree mode deleting a running session's git-ignored files, such as .env Fixed self-hosted runners with --use-anthropic-git-proxy deleting a non-empty directory named by GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL at startup: the runner now keeps it, ignores the variable and warns Fixed claude mcp add and claude mcp remove with project scope deleting other top-level keys from .mcp.json, such as $schema or another tool's servers Fixed /export overwriting an existing file without asking: the dialog now asks,
entries.title: v2.1.327

entries.summary: Added support for turning on Code Mode while agent teams are enabled; if you already turned it on, sessions with teams on now start in Code Mode; Added a startup warning when an --allowedTools, --disallowedTools or…
entries.text: What's changed Added support for turning on Code Mode while agent teams are enabled; if you already turned it on, sessions with teams on now start in Code Mode Added a startup warning when an --allowedTools, --disallowedTools or --tools value has an entry that doesn't look like a complete rule Added a message explaining why MCP servers stop loading when an administrator adds managed-mcp.json during a session Added a row to /status that says when your provider or an environment variable such as DISABLE_TELEMETRY turns features off Added a note in /plugin and claude plugin list when a malformed plugin.json field such as author or homepage is ignored Added Ctrl+O to show hidden startup notices Added a hint in the empty prompt that says what to do after a request fails Added an esc to stop footer hint in a subagent's view where Esc would stop it Added OTEL_RESOURCE_INCLUDE_HOST to include host.name and host.id in OpenTelemetry resource attributes (off by default) Added overflowX="scroll" on a mod's Box, and maxLines and wrap="clip" on its Text Fixed cp of a file being refused when only its source was covered by an Edit deny rule Fixed Bash commands that delete or overwrite files (find -delete, cat a > b, sort -o) being summed up in the transcript as a search or a read Fixed a misleading "Dangerous rm operation" warning in the Bash permission prompt on some commands with no rm that Claude Code can't read reliably Fixed background sessions losing the LLM gateway your shell exported
entries.title: v2.1.326

entries.summary: Fixed a security issue in how zstd-compressed responses are decoded; Added a spinner tip in VS Code and similar integrated terminals about re-running a notebook cell, shown once Claude has read or edited a Jupyter…
entries.text: What's changed Fixed a security issue in how zstd-compressed responses are decoded Added a spinner tip in VS Code and similar integrated terminals about re-running a notebook cell, shown once Claude has read or edited a Jupyter notebook Added a line under the error shown when your organization's policy blocks a request, saying how to continue: run /rewind and change the message, or run /clear Added a note for Claude when a sandboxed git checkout, git stash or autostash pull cannot update protected files such as those in .claude Fixed /security-review and skills' inline git commands stopping with an error in worktrees of bare repositories, --separate-git-dir checkouts and Android repo checkouts Fixed subagents with their own model being moved to the plan-mode model when the model setting is opusplan or haiku Fixed subagents on a different model sizing file reads and MCP results with the main session's model Fixed sessions on many third-party gateways and Foundry stopping with a context length error on every turn instead of compacting Fixed recent turns sometimes going missing from a resumed session after Claude Code stopped without a clean exit Fixed shell commands running in the launch directory after the working directory was deleted; the command now fails with a message and can be re-issued Fixed an approved plan edit being lost when the plansDirectory folder can't take it: the plan is now saved in the default plans folder, and a warning says where and why Fixed a saved son
entries.title: v2.1.325

entries.summary: Added Code Mode, an experimental opt-in in which Claude writes JavaScript to call its tools; see  to turn it on, or to turn it off for an organization; Added engines["claude-code"] to plugin.json: plugins outside their…
entries.text: What's changed Added Code Mode, an experimental opt-in in which Claude writes JavaScript to call its tools; see https://code.claude.com/docs/en/code-mode to turn it on, or to turn it off for an organization Added engines["claude-code"] to plugin.json: plugins outside their stated Claude Code version range are not installed, updated or loaded, and install and update pick the newest version that fits Added type checking of a plugin's TypeScript hooks module to claude plugin validate; each finding is a warning, and --strict fails on it Added to claude plugin validate the $ nouns a mod's engine.create hook adds, withholds or replaces Added support for CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_MODEL in managed settings for Claude Desktop sessions on third-party providers (takes effect once Claude Desktop includes this version) Added an options menu (stop, switch to usage credits, upgrade) when a model needs usage credits that are turned off or used up Added a progress heartbeat every 30 seconds while hooks run long in claude -p and SDK sessions, so a host such as Claude Desktop won't end the turn as hung (once it includes this version) Added .docx support to Artifact tool asset uploads Added a /diff to close hint to the diff panel, and the keys that focus and close a panel to the ? shortcut guide Added a start-up warning for Bash allow rules with a * in a variable's value, such as Bash(PORT=* npm run dev) Added a warning when a plugin's language server can't start, naming the server and what to check

entries.summary: Added Claude Fable 5.2 (claude-fable-5-2), now the default Fable model — 1M context, $8/$40 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads; Added --settings <file> to claude remote-control, which applies a settings file to every…
entries.text: What's changed Added Claude Fable 5.2 (claude-fable-5-2), now the default Fable model — 1M context, $8/$40 per Mtok with $0.20/Mtok cache reads Added --settings <file> to claude remote-control, which applies a settings file to every session it starts; if the file changes, no new session starts until you restart claude remote-control Fixed MCP OAuth requests sending secrets such as refresh tokens to another host when a server redirected them Fixed a case where a read-only Bash command ran outside the sandbox without a permission prompt Fixed a case where Bash permission checks judged a file write from the wrong folder and didn't prompt Fixed deny rules and protected-file prompts not applying to the file that a cp or mv into a directory writes Fixed the "Draws from usage credits" note showing after a switch to Fable on Enterprise seats whose plan includes Fable Fixed the fallback model sometimes declining a request or mentioning a stopped response when the first model was blocked before replying Fixed claude mcp login printing a SEP-2352 issuer warning each time you sign in again to a server that Claude Code registered with Fixed NotebookEdit deleting or overwriting a notebook's first cell when the call named no cell, on network paths (UNC shares, WSL folders, /net mounts) Fixed Edit changing the first of several matches, replacing a whole file on an empty old_string, or editing a notebook as text, on network paths (UNC shares, WSL folders, /net mounts) Fixed /config showing Ma

entries.summary: Changed auto mode with telemetry or feature flags off, including behind LLM gateways: calls the server can't check are asked about or denied, with no fallback to the built-in classifier; set…
entries.text: What's changed Changed auto mode with telemetry or feature flags off, including behind LLM gateways: calls the server can't check are asked about or denied, with no fallback to the built-in classifier; set CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0 to keep using it (Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry are unchanged) Changed auto mode behind an LLM gateway: CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1 turns on the server-side check even with CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS set; if managed settings set the latter, they must set the 1 too Added support for MCP tasks in the terminal: when an MCP server runs a tool call as a task, Claude Code moves it to the background right away and tells Claude the result when it finishes Added the CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASK_BACKGROUND environment variable to make Claude Code wait for an MCP task inside its tool call instead of moving it to the background right away Added permissions.denyInsteadOfPrompting setting: a tool call that would wait on a permission prompt is denied and the turn continues, in terminal sessions, subagents and teammates Added /claude-api latency-optimize to find where your Claude API code makes people wait and try faster settings against your eval Added the CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEATURE_FLAGS environment variable, which stops feature-flag fetching without turning off telemetry; every flag then uses its built-in default Added spend for today, this week and this month to /usage for developers behind a Claude apps gateway who have no spend limit, when
